'''Pressure maintenance hatches''', also known as '''garbage hatches''', were the [[Magnetic seal/Legends|magnetically sealed]] [[hatch]]es which provided access to [[Garbage compactor/Legends|garbage mashers]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]].
